visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor home environment, a woman with short dark hair in a white vest holds a baby in a yellow outfit with a striped bib. (3) A pink graphic card appears with text indicating a time skip. (4) The man is now lying in a white baby crib, looking exhausted, with the crying baby resting on his chest in a dimly lit room. (5) On a gray couch, the man drinks from a clear glass while the baby drinks from a bottle. (6) A hand presents a gold-colored gift box featuring a red phoenix and a golden fish graphic. (7) Close-up shots show red and orange foil packets labeled '日月養生' inside the box. (8) A red packet is placed into a glass jug of hot water to warm up. (9) The man is shown outdoors on a grassy mountain slope (Alps) with snow-capped peaks in the background, holding a red packet. (10) The man pours a yellow liquid from an orange packet into a bowl of green porridge and stirs it. (11) The woman sits in a gray armchair in a room with shelves of crystals and decorations, speaking to the camera. (12) The man mops a wooden floor while wearing the baby in a front-facing carrier. (13) The man sits on the couch holding the baby, speaking directly to the camera with promotional text overlays.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The man wears a white t-shirt and later a blue outdoor jacket; the woman has short hair and wears a white vest or a dark t-shirt; the baby wears a yellow romper and a striped bib.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A typical domestic interior with curtains, a baby crib, a gray sofa, and a living room with shelves containing crystals. One sequence takes place in an alpine mountain setting with snow and grass.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Soft acoustic guitar BGM begins. A female voice speaks in a calm, slightly weary tone. (2) A male voice enters with high intensity and an authoritative, upbeat pitch, conveying confidence. (3) A sharp transient SFX of a baby crying triggers a new phase, accompanied by a sudden shift in the male speaker's tone to a more exhausted, lower-pitch delivery. (4) A metallic clink and percussive thud mark a transition to a faster-paced narration in Taiwanese Hokkien (Hoklo), describing parental struggles. (5) Bubbling and pouring liquid SFX (short spectral bandwidth) are heard as the narrator explains product preparation. (6) Upbeat pop-folk BGM swells as the male narrator lists nutritional benefits with high articulation clarity. (7) A slight ambient texture shift to outdoor wind noise occurs as the man speaks from the Alps. (8) Slurping and spoon-clinking sounds are heard during a feeding sequence. (9) The female voice returns with moderate arousal, leading into the final male monologue which concludes with a crisp digital UI 'ding' SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Solution/Evidence -> Testimonial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a strategic marketing piece for 'Fang Zhi' chicken and fish essence. It begins with a relatable skit about the exhaustion of parenting and the man's failed attempt to be a 'hero' father due to low energy. It then transitions into a detailed product showcase, using scientific claims (clinical trials) and nutritional facts to establish credibility, followed by a domestic scene demonstrating the product's benefits for the whole family, ending with a call to action and a discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal praise of benefits, brand logo overlays, and a specific promotional discount code provided at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media ad using a comedic skit to hook the audience before pivoting to a standard health product infomercial style. The use of regional dialect (Hoklo) adds local appeal.
